title: Test Gap: Add test case for watchdog punching
author: domingo-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the test gap

For supported platforms, add a test case for checking watchdog is armed periodically without having to explicitly call `arm()` manually

### Affected Area

Watchdog API

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

Lack of test coverage for the watchdog punching behavior on supported platforms

comments.author: domingo-nexthop
comments.body: @yxieca I think the 2 PRs address different test gaps. The test cases added in #22361 check whether `watchdogutil` is supported and whether the hw watchdog is armed. The test cases proposed in #24186 check for the regular arming of the hw watchdog for platforms that have the watchdog enabled permanently.

### Description of PR


Add test case for checking watchdog punching arming watchdog without calling `arm()` on platforms that have watchdog armed permanently.

Summary:
Resolves https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/24185

### Type of change

- [x] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Add test case for checking watchdog is being armed periodically without having to call `arm` explicitly manually. 

#### How did you do it?

- Add a parameter to the test config to indicate if platform has watchdog punching enabled all the time
- Check that watchdog is armed
- Sleep for `remaining_time` as indicated by watchdog API
- Check that watchdog is still armed

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run all test cases with the parameter `has_watchdog_punching` set to true. When the parameter is missing or is set to false, ensure the `test_punching_arm ` test is skipped with all other test cases passing.
